steps.title: Prometheus Metrics Exporter Setup
steps.description: Construct an application metrics endpoint exporting OpenMetrics / Prometheus formatted telemetry (Counter, Gauge, Histogram).
tasks: Include standard metrics: `# HELP http_requests_total Total HTTP requests`, `# TYPE http_requests_total counter`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/monitoring/metrics.prom && grep -q 'http_requests_total' /home/student/monitoring/metrics.prom && grep -q 'process_resident_memory_bytes' /home/student/monitoring/metrics.prom && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Prometheus Scraper Configuration (prometheus.yml)
steps.description: Write a production `prometheus.yml` configuration defining scrape intervals, evaluation intervals, and static/Kubernetes service discovery targets.

verification.command: test -f /home/student/monitoring/prometheus.yml && grep -q 'scrape_interval' /home/student/monitoring/prometheus.yml && grep -q 'job_name' /home/student/monitoring/prometheus.yml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Prometheus Alerting Rules & SLI Thresholds
steps.description: Formulate PromQL alerting rules for High Error Rate (>5% 5xx responses) and CrashLoopBackOff container restarts.

verification.command: test -f /home/student/monitoring/alert_rules.yml && grep -q 'HighErrorRate' /home/student/monitoring/alert_rules.yml && grep -q 'severity: critical' /home/student/monitoring/alert_rules.yml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Structured JSON Logging with Trace Correlation
steps.description: Build a structured logger that injects OpenTelemetry compatible `trace_id` and `span_id` into all application log outputs for distributed tracing.
tasks: Ensure every log line outputs JSON: `{"timestamp": "...", "level": "ERROR", "trace_id": "...", "message": "..."}`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/monitoring/app_traced.log && grep -q 'trace_id' /home/student/monitoring/app_traced.log && grep -q 'timestamp' /home/student/monitoring/app_traced.log && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: RED Method Observability Dashboard Spec
steps.description: Construct a Grafana dashboard JSON panel specification monitoring Rate, Errors, and Duration (RED method).
tasks: Define panels for Request Rate (`rate(http_requests_total[1m])`), Error Ratio, and p99 Latency (`histogram_quantile(0.99, ...)` )

verification.command: test -f /home/student/monitoring/grafana_dashboard.json && python3 -m json.tool /home/student/monitoring/grafana_dashboard.json >/dev/null && grep -q 'histogram_quantile' /home/student/monitoring/grafana_dashboard.json && echo PASS || echo FAIL
